defs.measure: Top-1% multiple: share of top-1% lineups holding X / share of all lineups holding X (1.00 is the field). Top-10% beside it; points as the backup. Drafted picks only, swaps apart. Season reads: the night is the unit.
defs.header: Your entries, cash rate, top-10% and top-1% finishes against expected (10% and 1% of your entries), and ROI ((won - fees) / fees). Field cash rate: share of all entries that cashed.
defs.finish: Each lineup's finish as a percentile of its contest (place / entries). Season: share of your lineups in each 1% band (the field is 1% in every band). Then how often you reached each line, the cash line to the top 0.1%: your finishes there over what the field's rate gives (1.00x is the field; cash uses each night's field cash rate).
defs.t1: Afternoon T1 (the button's tier at the PM lock). Every pair ETR's order and ADP's order put differently: the top-1% multiple of ETR's first minus ADP's first, averaged for the night. Marker: the side your PM board took. Tally on points, pushes under 3.
defs.t2: Afternoon T2, the same ETR-vs-ADP pairs. Elite-break teams (contest side's t2-elite-break) against the rest. Your 1/2 and 2/3 turn decisions: your share against the field's, each with its top-1% multiple.
defs.pod: The main read on whether your moves help. Every real pod and seat replayed off your locked list and off each other list, placed in the real standings (contest side's pod replay). Each bar: your list's top-10% (or top-1%) rate minus that list's, in percentage points, with its 80% range from resampling nights; right of zero, your list did better. Season, and since the list's rules went live (rule_dates.json). Below it, PM only: which ETR version the PM should use (the ETR-tier button, pure ETR, ETR with the button's T5 rule; each row the first minus the second, since the PM button went to ETR tiers), and top 1% at your real seats against your list there. Each tier's own read (your moves in it, its ETR order) opens that tier's card below.
defs.t34: Secondary to the pod replay. Your moves against the button in the tier (takes_history.csv, Q-tagged pairs left out): for each move, the top-1% multiple of the player you moved up minus the player you moved down, in that window; summed for the night, with a running total. Tally on points, pushes under 3. VALUE / normal / PRICEY: your share of lineups holding one against the field's, each group's top-1% multiple.
defs.t5: Drafted picks only. Lineups holding a T5 pick drafted in under 60% of pods, one at or over 60%, and (their own group) a T4 PRICEY player the button dropped into T5 (its tier before the T5 rules; left out of the two 60% groups so those read T5 leverage only): your share of lineups against the field's, each group's top-1% multiple. Second: your round-6 pick (each lineup's latest-ADP drafted pick, played) against the field's average round-6 pick, in points. Swaps apart: your swap list's player against the one your PM list would have taken, in points.

labels.fn: (f-nodrop) the ETR-tier button, ETR's T4 PRICEY kept in T4 (PM)
